Uses Codex browser actions and places a screenshot beside every meaningful Action
Does not treat Login, Generate, a task ID or a loading state as success
Records result and design rationale for each action
Produces a report package that can pass the explicit research report gate
Reads official repository, official documentation, license and recent activity
Separates framework, code, model weights, body models and datasets
Maps the candidate to current Nomi file and line evidence
Chooses direct adoption, interaction borrowing, backend adaptation or rejection with trade-offs

Marks the study blocked on missing credentials, ambiguity, authentication or rate limits
